A medium for recording information in the form of writing or images, typically composed of many pages (made of papyrus, parchment, vellum, or paper) bound together and protected by a cover.
A written work published in a print or electronic medium for the purpose of propagating research results or academic analysis. Journal articles are assumed to be peer reviewed.
Also known as a thesis, is a document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification presenting the author's research and findings.
Also called books or chapters or parts, are parts. A distinct part of a book.

Also known as fieldnotes, are qualitative notes recorded by scientists or researchers in the course of field research, during or after their observation of a specific organism or phenomenon they are studying.
